'''Winsafra Padme in her Throne, only way to go(with a new strategy section for VEEZ)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 27 February 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]

== Strategy ==

Veez is it? Dude, how can you possibly say this is a crappy objective? Force drains are limited to 2 for oppponet when flipped, any battle destiny greater than 3 i can use 1 force to cancel, he loses 2 force for each battleground i control with amidala or panaka? its evil. you are right though, lightsaber combat is a hard win. But, thats why i play young obi-wan(he's not a jedi and doesn't flip LSC). If i play lightsaber combat, qui-gon never comes out, an if he does, he stays outside! Once again, this is most definitely a discusting objective, the limited charater base DOESNT MATTER!  the deck more than makes up for it when flipped. Just thought i'd give you my thoughts on why this objective ROCKS.

Carl
